title: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
text: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi) is a Central Sector scheme launched on 1st February 2019. Under this scheme, an income support of Rs. 6000/- per year is provided to all landholding farmer families across India. The amount is paid in three equal installments of Rs. 2000/- each every four months directly into the bank accounts of the beneficiaries. Eligibility: All landholding farmers' families with cultivable land are eligible. Exclusions include institutional landholders, farmer families holding constitutional posts, serving or retired officers of state/central government services, professionals such as doctors, engineers, lawyers, chartered accountants, and persons who paid income tax in last assessment year. Benefits: Rs. 6000 per year directly transferred to bank account. How to Apply: Farmers can register at the PM-KISAN portal pmkisan.gov.in or through the PM-KISAN Mobile App. Documents required: Aadhaar card, bank account details, land records.

title: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY (Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana)
text: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY is the world's largest health assurance scheme, launched on 23rd September 2018. It provides a health cover of Rs. 5 lakhs per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalisation to over 10.74 crore poor and vulnerable families. Eligibility: Families identified based on Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC) 2011 data. Includes rural deprivation criteria and occupational category of urban workers. Benefits: Rs. 5 lakh per family per year for hospitalisation. Cashless and paperless access to health care services. Covers pre and post hospitalisation expenses. How to Apply: Visit the nearest Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY empanelled hospital or Common Service Centre. Check eligibility on pmjay.gov.in or call 14555. Documents: Aadhaar card, ration card.

title: National Scholarship Portal - Central Government Scholarships
text: The National Scholarship Portal (NSP) is a one-stop platform for students seeking scholarships from various central government ministries. Scholarships available include: Pre-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST/OBC/Minority students, Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST/OBC/Minority students, Merit-cum-Means Scholarship, Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships for College and University Students. Eligibility varies by scheme but generally targets students from economically weaker sections. Income criteria for most scholarships is parental income below Rs. 2.5 lakh per annum for pre-matric and Rs. 6 lakh for post-matric. Benefits: Financial assistance ranging from Rs. 1000 to Rs. 25000 per year depending on the scheme. How to Apply: Register on scholarships.gov.in, fill the application form, upload required documents. Documents: Aadhaar card, income certificate, bank details, bonafide certificate from institution.

title: PMSBY - Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
text: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY) is an accidental insurance scheme launched on 9 May 2015. It offers accidental death and disability coverage for Rs. 2 lakhs at an annual premium of just Rs. 20. Eligibility: Any individual aged 18-70 years with a savings bank account who gives his consent to join and pay the premium. Benefits: Rs. 2 lakh for accidental death or total permanent disability, Rs. 1 lakh for partial permanent disability. How to Apply: Through participating banks or insurance companies. Can be enrolled via bank branch, bank's website, mobile banking, Common Service Centre, or Insurance agents. Auto-debit from savings bank account. Documents: Bank account, Aadhaar card.

title: PMJJBY - Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
text: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY) is a life insurance scheme launched on 9 May 2015. It offers life insurance coverage of Rs. 2 lakhs for death due to any cause at an annual premium of Rs. 436 per year. Eligibility: People in the age group of 18 to 50 years having a bank account. Benefits: Rs. 2 lakh life insurance coverage for death due to any cause. How to Apply: Through participating life insurance companies or banks. The scheme is offered by Life Insurance Corporation of India and various other insurance companies. Application through bank branch or online. Documents: Bank account, Aadhaar card.

title: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
text: Atal Pension Yojana (APY) is a pension scheme focused on the unorganized sector workers. It was launched on 9 May 2015. Under the APY, guaranteed minimum pension of Rs. 1000/- to Rs. 5000/- per month will be given at the age of 60 years depending on the contributions by the subscribers. Eligibility: Any citizen of India between 18-40 years of age with a savings bank account. Benefits: Guaranteed pension of Rs. 1000 to Rs. 5000 per month depending on contribution level. Government also co-contributes 50% of the total contribution or Rs. 1000 per annum (whichever is lower) to eligible subscribers who joined between June 2015 and December 2015. How to Apply: Through bank branches, Common Service Centres, or Aadhaar Enabled Payment System. Documents: Bank account, Aadhaar card, mobile number.

title: PM Mudra Yojana (PMMY) - Micro Business Loans
text: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY) is a scheme launched on 8 April 2015 for providing loans up to Rs 10 lakh to the non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises. These loans are classified as MUDRA loans under PMMY. Types: Shishu (loans up to Rs 50,000), Kishor (loans from Rs 50,001 to Rs 5 lakh), Tarun (loans from Rs 5 lakh to Rs 10 lakh). Eligibility: Any Indian citizen who has a business plan for income generating activity in manufacturing, processing, trading or service sector. Benefits: Low-interest collateral-free loans for small businesses. How to Apply: Through public sector banks, private sector banks, Regional Rural Banks, Co-operative Banks, Micro Finance Institutions, and NBFCs. Online at udyamimitra.in. Documents: Identity proof, address proof, business plan.

title: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) - Free LPG Connections
text: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) was launched on 1st May 2016 to safeguard the health of women and children by providing LPG connections to BPL households. The scheme provides free LPG connections to women belonging to poor households. Eligibility: Women from BPL households who are above 18 years of age and who do not have LPG connection in the household. Priority given to Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana beneficiaries, SC/ST households, Most Backward Classes, Antyodaya Anna Yojana households, tea garden and forest dwellers, and people residing in islands. Benefits: Free LPG cylinder connection (one connection per household). How to Apply: Through nearest oil company's distribution office or Common Service Centre. Documents: BPL card, Aadhaar card, bank account details.

title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY) - Housing for All
text: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY) was launched on 25th June 2015 with the aim of providing housing to all by 2022. The scheme provides financial assistance to eligible beneficiaries for construction of permanent pucca house. PMAY-Gramin: For rural areas. EWS/LIG category - up to Rs 1.5 lakh assistance. PMAY-Urban: For urban areas. Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS) provides interest subsidy on home loans. Eligibility: Beneficiary family should not own a pucca house anywhere in India. For PMAY-Urban, must belong to EWS (annual income up to Rs 3 lakh), LIG (Rs 3-6 lakh), MIG-I (Rs 6-12 lakh) or MIG-II (Rs 12-18 lakh) categories. Benefits: Financial assistance up to Rs 1.5 lakh for rural areas, interest subsidy of 3-6.5% on home loans for urban areas. How to Apply: For rural - through Gram Panchayat. For urban - through local urban local body or bank. Documents: Aadhaar card, income certificate, land ownership documents.

title: Swachh Bharat Mission - Clean India Mission
text: Swachh Bharat Mission was launched on 2nd October 2014 to achieve open defecation free India and improve solid waste management. Individual Household Latrine (IHHL) construction assistance of Rs 12,000 is provided to BPL households and above poverty line households with SC/ST, small and marginal farmers, landless labourers with house sites, households with disabled persons and women headed households. Eligibility: Households without a toilet and belonging to the eligible categories. Benefits: Financial incentive of Rs 12,000 for construction of toilet. How to Apply: Through Gram Panchayat or Block office. Documents: Aadhaar card, bank account, land ownership or certificate of residence.

title: PM Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) - Crop Insurance
text: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) was launched on 18 February 2016. It is a comprehensive crop insurance scheme to provide financial support to farmers suffering crop loss/damage due to unforeseen events. Premium rates: 2% for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi crops, 5% for annual commercial/horticultural crops. The balance premium is paid by the government. Eligibility: All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers growing notified crops in notified areas. Compulsory for loanee farmers, voluntary for non-loanee farmers. Benefits: Coverage of crop loss due to natural calamities, pests and diseases, post-harvest losses. How to Apply: Through banks, insurance companies, Common Service Centres, or the PMFBY portal. Documents: Land records, Aadhaar card, bank account, sowing certificate.

title: e-Shram Portal - Unorganised Worker Registration
text: e-Shram portal was launched on 26th August 2021 for creating a National Database of Unorganised Workers (NDUW). Registered workers get an e-Shram card and are entitled to various social security benefits. All unorganised workers can register on e-Shram portal. Eligibility: Unorganised workers aged 16-59 years who are not covered under EPF, ESIC, or NPS (Government). This includes construction workers, migrant workers, gig workers, platform workers, street vendors, domestic workers, agricultural workers etc. Benefits: e-Shram Card (UAN), accidental insurance cover of Rs. 2 lakh under PMSBY, priority access to various government schemes. How to Apply: Self-registration at eshram.gov.in or through Common Service Centres (CSC). Documents: Aadhaar card, mobile number linked to Aadhaar, bank account number.

title: MGNREGS - Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme
text: The Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA) guarantees 100 days of wage employment in a financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work. This is a demand-driven scheme. Eligibility: Any adult member of a rural household willing to do unskilled manual work. Benefits: Guaranteed 100 days of employment per year. Wages are paid as per the wage rate notified by the state government. Compensation for work not provided within 15 days. Work within 5 km of the applicant's residence. One-third of the workers in each work-site should be women. How to Apply: Apply at the local Gram Panchayat with a household job card application. Documents: Aadhaar card, photograph, bank/post office account.

title: PMKVY - Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (Skill Development)
text: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY) is the flagship scheme of the Ministry of Skill Development & Entrepreneurship (MSDE). The objective of the scheme is to enable Indian youth to take up industry-relevant skill training that will help them secure a better livelihood. Training is provided through Short Term Training (STT) and Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL). Eligibility: Any Indian national who is an unemployed youth or school/college dropout. Benefits: Free skill training in various trade sectors. Financial rewards for successful completion of assessment. Preference in national/state government job listings. How to Apply: Through PMKVY training centres (find at pmkvy.gov.in) or through Common Service Centres. Documents: Aadhaar card, bank account, educational certificates.

title: DAY-NRLM - Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana National Rural Livelihoods Mission
text: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM) was launched by the Ministry of Rural Development in June 2011. The mission aims at creating efficient and effective institutional platforms for the rural poor enabling them to increase household income through sustainable livelihood enhancements and improved access to financial services. Key component is organizing women into Self-Help Groups (SHGs). Eligibility: Rural BPL households, particularly women. Priority to SC/ST, minority communities, disabled persons, migrant workers. Benefits: Organize into SHGs, access to bank loans at 7% interest rate, revolving fund up to Rs. 15,000 per SHG, Community Investment Fund. How to Apply: Through the local Block Development Office or Gram Panchayat. Documents: BPL card, Aadhaar card, bank account.

title: Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students
text: Post-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Castes (SC) students is provided by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment to assist students belonging to SC category. The scholarship is provided for studies at post-matriculation or post-secondary stage. Eligibility: Students belonging to SC category, pursuing studies at post-matric level. Parental income should not exceed Rs. 2.5 lakh per annum. Benefits: Maintenance allowance, study tour charges, thesis typing/printing charges, book allowance, additional allowances. Ranges from Rs. 380 to Rs. 1200 per month depending on the course level. How to Apply: Through the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in). Documents: Caste certificate, income certificate, Aadhaar card, bank account, bonafide certificate.

title: Pre-Matric Scholarship for ST Students
text: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Tribe (ST) students is provided by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs to ST students studying in Class 9 and 10. Eligibility: Students of ST category studying in Class 9 or 10 in recognized schools. Parental income should not exceed Rs. 2 lakh per annum. Day scholars and hostellers both eligible. Benefits: Day scholars: Rs. 150 per month plus Rs. 750 per year for study expenses. Hostellers: Rs. 350 per month plus Rs. 1000 per year for study expenses. How to Apply: Through the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in). Documents: ST certificate, income certificate, Aadhaar card, bank account, school bonafide certificate.

title: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships for College & University Students
text: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships (CSS) for College and University Students is a scholarship by the Ministry of Education for meritorious students from low-income families to meet part of their day-to-day expenses while pursuing higher studies. Eligibility: Students who have passed Class 12 from a recognized board and are in top 20 percentile in their respective discipline, pursuing full-time regular courses (not correspondence courses), and whose parental income does not exceed Rs. 8 lakh per annum. Benefits: Rs. 12000 per annum for first three years of undergraduate study, Rs. 20000 per annum at the post-graduate level. How to Apply: Through the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in). Documents: Class 12 mark sheet, income certificate, Aadhaar card, bank account.

title: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
text: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS) is a centrally sponsored scheme by the Ministry of Education to award scholarships to meritorious students of economically weaker sections to arrest their drop out at Class VIII and encourage them to continue study at secondary stage. Eligibility: Students who have passed Class VII examination with 55% marks (50% for SC/ST students), studying in Class VIII in government/government-aided schools, and whose parental income does not exceed Rs. 3.5 lakh per annum. Benefits: Rs. 12000 per year (Rs. 1000 per month). How to Apply: Through the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in). Documents: Income certificate, Class VII mark sheet, Aadhaar card, bank account.

title: Scholarship for Minority Students - Pre & Post Matric
text: Scholarships for Minority Students are provided by the Ministry of Minority Affairs to students belonging to notified minority communities (Muslims, Christians, Sikhs, Buddhists, Jains and Zoroastrians/Parsis). Pre-Matric Scholarship: For students studying in Class 1 to 10. Post-Matric Scholarship: For students studying in Class 11 and above (including professional and technical courses). Merit-cum-Means Scholarship: For students pursuing professional and technical courses. Eligibility: Students belonging to notified minority communities. Income criteria applies (generally up to Rs. 1 lakh for pre-matric, Rs. 2 lakh for post-matric). Benefits: Maintenance allowance and tuition fee reimbursement ranging from Rs. 1000 to Rs. 30000 depending on the scheme. How to Apply: Through National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in). Documents: Minority community certificate, income certificate, Aadhaar card, bank account.

title: Shakti Scheme (Karnataka Free Bus Travel for Women)
text: Shakti Scheme is a flagship welfare initiative of the Government of Karnataka launched on 11th June 2023. Under the Shakti Yojana, all women, female students, and transgender persons who are residents of Karnataka can travel completely free of cost in state-run road transport corporation buses. The scheme covers KSRTC (Karnataka State Road Transport Corporation), BMTC (Bangalore Metropolitan Transport Corporation), NWKRTC (North Western Karnataka Road Transport Corporation), and KKRTC (Kalyana Karnataka Road Transport Corporation) ordinary, express, and city buses within the state boundaries of Karnataka. Eligibility: All women and transgender persons domiciled in Karnataka. Benefits: 100% free bus travel across Karnataka on state transport buses. 50% of seats in KSRTC, NWKRTC, and KKRTC ordinary and express buses are reserved for men, while the remaining 50% are reserved for women. How to Apply: Beneficiaries can travel by showing a government-issued photo ID card with residential address proof (such as Aadhaar Card, Voter ID Card, Driving License, or BPL Ration Card) to get a zero-fare ticket. Permanent Shakti Smart Cards can be applied online via the Seva Sindhu portal (sevasindhu.karnataka.gov.in) or offline at Bangalore One, Karnataka One, and Grama One centres. Documents: Aadhaar card with Karnataka address, passport-size photo.

title: Gruha Lakshmi Scheme (Karnataka Rs. 2000 Monthly Support for Women)
text: Gruha Lakshmi Scheme was launched by the Government of Karnataka in August 2023. Under this scheme, financial assistance of Rs. 2,000 per month is directly transferred to the bank account of the woman head of every eligible household (Kartharu) in Karnataka. Eligibility: Woman head of household listed on Antyodaya, BPL, or APL ration cards issued by Karnataka Government. Women or husbands who pay income tax or GST are not eligible. Benefits: Rs. 2,000 monthly cash assistance transferred via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). How to Apply: Apply on Seva Sindhu portal or via Karnataka One, Grama One, and Bangalore One centres. Documents: Aadhaar card of woman head and husband, ration card, bank account linked to Aadhaar.

title: Gruha Jyothi Scheme (Karnataka Free Electricity Up to 200 Units)
text: Gruha Jyothi Scheme is a welfare program of the Government of Karnataka offering up to 200 units of free electricity per month for all residential households in Karnataka, launched in August 2023. Eligibility: All domestic consumers in Karnataka whose average monthly electricity consumption plus 10% is within 200 units. Applicable only to residential households, not commercial establishments. Benefits: Zero electricity bill if consumption is within the eligible monthly entitlement (up to 200 units). How to Apply: Register on Seva Sindhu portal using consumer account ID and Aadhaar card. Documents: Electricity bill Account ID, Aadhaar card, tenancy agreement or ownership document.
